title: A finite field extension has finitely many embeddings over the base
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $K/F$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] with $\dim_FK<\infty$, and let $L/F$ be any field extension. Then the set of $F$-algebra homomorphisms $K\to L$ is finite, with at most $\dim_FK$ elements.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 09H8 (lemma-count-embeddings-explicitly, line 1326) for L an algebraic closure, with deg_s(P_i) <= deg(P_i) (remark after Definition Tag 09H5, line 1262); an F-map K -> L lands in the algebraic closure of F in L, which embeds into an algebraic closure (Lemma Tag 09GU)
